timeout.title: This site took too long to respond
timeout.message: The server didn't respond in time. It might be overloaded, or there may be a problem with your connection.

notFound.title: Server not found
notFound.message: Zen couldn't find a server at this address. Check the address for typos, or try again in a moment.

refused.title: Connection refused
refused.message: The server refused the connection. The site might be down, or it may not accept connections on this port.

reset.title: Connection was reset
reset.message: The connection to the server was interrupted. This is usually temporary.

tls.title: Secure connection failed
tls.message: Zen couldn't establish a secure connection to this site. Retrying may reconnect without Zen's filtering for this site.

unreachable.title: This site can't be reached
unreachable.message: Zen couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, or try again in a moment.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.message: Zen hit an internal error while processing this page. Retrying might help.
